scope: Post-study design review using primary training families only; no new fit or threshold change
conclusions: The 800 ms goal and 200/500/1000/2000 ms candidates leave a coarse interval decision. A failed all-candidate workload permits abstention, not a safe alternative interval.
Safety abstention can be useful, but is distinct from the prospectively required safe interval/coverage benefit. The existing gate is not changed.
The fixed goal and invariant timeout/priority/buffering do not train behavior across those dimensions.
Configured UART frame rate is a declared value, not the independently measured actual reporting rate.
Current contexts intentionally bind the supported drivers, topology and firmware. Unknown peripherals must still configure through supported drivers while advice abstains.
prospective_next_study: First finish the radio/static platform and freeze its execution context; retain existing studies under their original hashes.
Use independently collected protocol service costs and actual stream rates as candidate model inputs, with missing/saturated measurements producing abstention.
Predeclare operational goals, candidate ranges and an objective that simple interval-plus-source-period rules do not already solve; preserve baselines and report negative results.
Keep goal variants, repeated sessions and near-duplicate workload profiles within the same family split. Reserve whole new families before any labels are inspected.
Run an additional supported peripheral type and separate-session holdout before claiming cross-device generalization.
Use temporal/grouped evaluation, deterministic export and bounded on-target inference; keep hardware admission and explicit Apply authoritative.
